title: Siebenhuhner-2020-genuine-10.1371/journal.pbio.3000685
description: This derivative dataset repackages the public Dryad release accompanying Siebenhühner et al. (2020), providing per-subject connectivity matrices computed from resting-state stereo-EEG (59 epilepsy patients) and MEG (19 healthy participants, plus a 10-participant eyes-open/eyes-closed cohort). Measures include phase synchrony (PLV, wPLI), cross-frequency phase synchrony, phase-amplitude coupling and amplitude-envelope coupling, each with surrogate values, together with supporting files, neuropsychological scores and plotted figure values. Raw recordings are not included because of data privacy regulations.
methods_description: SEEG: 10-min eyes-closed resting state, 1000 Hz, contacts localised with CT and assigned to the 148-parcel Destrieux atlas, closest-white-matter referencing, exclusion of epileptic-zone and subcortical contacts and of interictal-event windows, Morlet wavelets (m=5) at 49 frequencies from 1.2 to 315 Hz. MEG: 10-min eyes-open resting state recorded with a 306-channel Elekta/MEGIN system, tSSS and ICA cleaning, MNE source modelling collapsed to 200 split-Destrieux parcels with fidelity weighting, Morlet filter bank from 1.1 to 315 Hz.
